title: Angel Heart
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A young Taiwanese assassin code-named Glass Heart tries to end her life after a traumatic kill and survives through a heart transplant; the heart belonged to Kaori Makimura of City Hunter, and its memories lead her to Shinjuku (AniList; MangaUpdates). Kaori's fiancé Ryo Saeba, a retired 'sweeper', takes her in as a daughter named Xiang Ying, mixing standalone jobs with arcs about the cast's pasts; a parallel-universe spin-off of City Hunter in 33 volumes (Women Write About Comics review).
life_message: It holds up chosen family and the healing of a damaged person through love and second chances.
